title: Moving Inventory Estimate Worksheet
subtitle: Household Moving Inventory: prices observed scope, options, and exclusions.
description: Moving Inventory Estimate Worksheet covers inventory item, carton, room, handling instruction, custody event, and destination placement. The move coordinator records Household Moving Inventory observed scope, costs, options, and terms. Moving Inventory Estimate Worksheet keeps Household Moving Inventory exceptions visible until the move coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Moving Inventory Estimate Worksheet at origin residence, vehicle, storage point, destination, and room placement. Document inventory item, carton, room, handling instruction, custody event, and destination placement identity before Household Moving Inventory begins. Compare inventory item, carton, room, handling instruction, custody event, and destination placement findings with stated Household Moving Inventory criteria; route unresolved Household Moving Inventory issues to moving operations reviewer. For Moving Inventory Estimate Worksheet, confirm requirements for Household Moving Inventory. Ask moving operations reviewer to review Household Moving Inventory conditions beyond the move coordinator's role.

sections.title: Pricing evidence and service location
sections.guidance: For Household Moving Inventory, identify responsible parties, origin residence, vehicle, storage point, destination, and room placement, and the linked inventory item, carton, room, handling instruction, custody event, and destination placement source.

sections.guidance: Capture Household Moving Inventory facts for inventory item, carton, room, handling instruction, custody event, and destination placement; include result, limit, source, and next control.

sections.guidance: Resolve open Household Moving Inventory conditions; have move coordinator assign the next Household Moving Inventory owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.guidance: Pause Household Moving Inventory when a prohibited-item, access, equipment, custody, shortage, or damage exception remains unassigned. Retain the available Household Moving Inventory proof and route unresolved inventory item, carton, room, handling instruction, custody event, and destination placement scope to move coordinator.
